patch_description:
The current architecture suffers from underfitting due to excessive parameter sharing in the first layer. All ry_pre are identical, severely limiting feature extraction capacity. Prior Gen 2 achieved 0.65 test accuracy with individual RY parameters plus strategic 2-qubit parametrization.

This edit:
1. Restores individual RY parameters in Layer 1 (ry_0 through ry_8) to enable diverse feature encoding, matching the successful Gen 2 pattern
2. Merges crz_2 and crz_3 into a shared parameter "crz_mixed" on edges [0,8] and [1,3] to free parameters without losing expressivity
3. Adds CZ gate on [3,6] to increase mid-layer connectivity on a previously weak axis
4. Removes the final redundant RZ layer (Layer 3) that contributes to depth without improving generalization
5. Keeps only one final RY layer for output preparation, reducing circuit depth

Expected outcome: ~125 parameters with better expressivity, improved test accuracy to ~0.63-0.65 range, lower generalization gap, and faster convergence due to reduced depth.
